Hi Alyssa — thanks for the screenshot, very helpful. 10:30am PT today works for a triage; I'm booking 30 mins and inviting Karthik (partnerships ops) and Ben (field). 

High-level answers up front so the meeting is focused:

1) Deterministic mapping: we use a hierarchy of signals in this order — (1) Partner Center referral metadata (referral_id), (2) HubSpot account id, (3) Azure tenant id, (4) subscription tag. Provide as many as you can; we'll fallback to partner ops queue when signals are missing.

2) Minimal payload for immediate routing: HubSpot account id + Tenant ID + primary contact email. With those we can route to region-appropriate seller and surface the account in Redwood's co-sell dashboard.

3) Listing naming: include the market prefix and solution domain (e.g., contoso-observability-azure). This helps our internal filters for co-sell triage.

Action items for the call (so we're aligned):
- Contoso to provide a CSV with sample accounts + hubspot ids (Alyssa)
- Redwood to run mapping against our seller roster and return proposed seller assignments (Ben/Karthik)
- Agree CAN (can-convert) threshold for auto-assign vs manual route (team)

Attaching our "Azure listing & co-sell checklist" so you can see the fields we commonly consume.

See you at 10:30.

— Sofia

Sofia/Ben — quick internal note before the triage:

I reviewed the Partner Center screenshot Alyssa sent. A few operational heuristics I recommend we validate on the call so we can automate the mapping: 

- Primary heuristic: if referral_id present AND hubspot_account_id matches a Redwood account with a recent engagement (last 12 months), route to owning seller.
- Secondary heuristic: if hubspot id absent, use Azure Tenant ID + subscription tag and match to region-owned sellers (we maintain tenant->seller mapping via subscription owner tags).
- Fallback: partner-ops queue with escalation policy to Ben for accounts > $100k ARR.

I'll prep a short doc with rules (attached) and a sample script output that maps 12 Contoso accounts to sellers so we can walk deterministically on the call. Also: we should capture HubSpot record URLs in the referral so CS can see engagement history — add that to the checklist as a must-have.

Planned deliverables after triage:
- pc-referral-ownership-rules.docx (attached)
- sample mapping CSV with proposed seller assignments
- mutual action plan (MAP) with timelines for listing verification + co-sell enablement
